title: Contributing
subtitle: How to contribute to Qortex
description: Learn how to contribute to Qortex development, report bugs, suggest features, and submit pull requests.
content: We welcome contributions to Qortex! Whether you're fixing bugs, adding features, or improving documentation, your help is appreciated.

callouts.title: Getting Started
callouts.content: Before contributing, please read this guide and check our GitHub repository for current issues and discussions.

sections.title: Ways to Contribute
sections.content: There are many ways you can contribute to Qortex:

code.code:
🐛 Report bugs and issues
💡 Suggest new features
📝 Improve documentation
🧪 Write tests
🔧 Fix bugs and implement features
🎨 Improve the codebase
📖 Write tutorials and guides

sections.title: Development Setup
sections.content: To set up the development environment:

code.code:
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/darshannaik/qortex.git
cd qortex

# Install dependencies
pnpm install

# Run tests
pnpm test

# Build packages
pnpm build

# Start development server
pnpm dev

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch
3. Make your changes
4. Add tests if applicable
5. Run the test suite
6. Submit a pull request
